detail.overview: Compare Favourite SD8A840FA-HNT 8MP 40x Starlight IR WizMind Network PTZ Camera for Traffic Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 8MP Resolution • 40× Optical Zoom Provide Close Up Views Over Expansive Areas • Expansive Night View With up to 500m IR Distance for 24/7 Monitoring • 1/1.8" CMOS Sensor Ensures Premium Images • Supports Monitoring Up to 8 Illegal Parking Zones with Tour and Vehicle Recognition • Pedestrian Event Detection on Highways, Elevated Highways and Express Roads • 3 Lane Checkpoin Capture with Wrong-Way and Congestion Detection • IP67 for Protection Against Harsh Environments Sales Enquiry Datasheet
